evidence: Route: explicit code labels + data checks. S2 appendix prints 'EA1:'..'EA5:' before each wording, the same codes as the S1 columns the processing script melts by name. verify_zhang_2025_environ_awareness.R: (A) live EAk vs S1 EAk agree 292/292 ids for each k, no other EA column reaches full agreement (best other 174/292); (B) 5-factor CFA on S1 gives EA loadings 0.847/0.765/0.695/0.663/0.701 vs Table 2 0.847/0.765/0.695/0.663/0.701 (max |diff| 0.000; best of 119 non-identity permutations 0.006, the EA3<->EA5 swap); (C) live alpha 0.852 vs Table 2 0.852. Every item is distinguished from every other by its printed code label. Does NOT establish: that S2's EAk labels and Table 2's EAk labels are one labelling (both are the authors' own codes, untestable by statistics), nor that the English matches the administered Chinese wording.
